info.title: Portaliq Register
info.description: Register containing all schemas owned by the Portaliq external-portal application.

x-openregister.description: Portaliq — the fleet's shared external portal for clients and suppliers (ADR-046).

portalAccount.title: Portal Account
portalAccount.description: Links an external identity (eHerkenning / DigiD / eIDAS) to the subject reference used for RBAC scoping. Owned by Portaliq's auth edge; never publicly readable. See ADR-046 and openspec/changes/supplier-portal.

audience.description: Which external audience this account belongs to.

identityType.description: The external identity provider that authenticated this account.

identityRef.description: Pseudonymous identity reference from the IdP (e.g. eHerkenning KvK number for suppliers, or a pairwise pseudonym for clients). Not a raw BSN.

subjectRef.description: The reference the domain apps scope their data by (e.g. procest supplierRef). Server-derived; never accepted from the client.

organisation.description: The tenant (OpenRegister Organisation) this account belongs to.

displayName.description: Human-readable name for the portal UI.

email.description: Contact email for notifications (masked in logs).

lastLoginAt.description: Timestamp of the most recent successful login.

portalSession.title: Portal Session
portalSession.description: A bearer session issued by Portaliq's auth edge. Records the minted token id (jti) so sessions can be revoked. Owned by Portaliq; never publicly readable.

accountRef.description: Reference to the portalAccount this session was issued for.

subjectRef.description: The subject reference carried in the token (server-derived).

audience.description: The external audience of this session.

organisation.description: The tenant this session is scoped to.

jti.description: Unique token identifier (JWT jti claim) for revocation.

trustLevel.description: Assurance level of the authentication (e.g. eHerkenning EH3, DigiD Midden/Substantieel).

revoked.description: Whether the session has been explicitly revoked (logout / admin).
